links.outcome: AI performance non-inferiority across mammography vendors and screening sites
links.effect: DR with AI showed at least non-inferior recall rate, cancer detection rate, sensitivity, specificity and PPV for each mammography vendor and site, and superior recall rate, specificity, and PPV for some.
links.quote: DR with AI, compared with human DR, showed at least non-inferior recall rate, cancer detection rate, sensitivity, specificity and positive predictive value (PPV) for each mammography vendor and site, and superior recall rate, specificity, and PPV for some.

unlisted_practices: Using AI as an independent second reader in double-reading breast screening to reduce human workload

screen.reason: The study retrospectively simulates and evaluates a specific deployment workflow practice (AI replacing one human reader in double reading) across multiple vendors and sites.

primary.practice: AI as an independent second reader in double reading workflow
